    MedEx.Web (med_ex v0.1.0)

    Copy Markdown View Source

    Locates MedEx's packaged browser JavaScript assets.

    Host web applications serve these files as application/javascript under their own routes:

    • "session_hook.js" — LiveView hook helper (createMedExHook/1) for the clinician's receive-only WebRTC preview peer.
    • "pcm_capture.js" — patient-browser capture helper (startPCM/4) for 48 kHz mono PCM16LE microphone capture over an authenticated WebSocket.
    • "pcm_worklet.js" — AudioWorkletProcessor ("med-ex-indexed-pcm") loaded by startPCM/4.

    asset_path(name)

    @spec asset_path(String.t()) :: String.t()

    Returns the absolute filesystem path to a packaged browser asset.

    Accepts "session_hook.js", "pcm_capture.js", or "pcm_worklet.js".
